Higher gas prices may be among the economic headwinds taking their toll on Republican voters. The University of Michigan’s consumer sentiment survey found that Republicans’ consumer sentiment fell 9.5 points from July to August. This is one of the biggest monthly drops in the survey’s history, and it outpaced the overall decline in consumer sentiment of 8 percent.
